item.title: City Holds Meeting on Bradley Lake and Sunset Park
item.description: Adam Collins -- Sturgeon Bay officials met at City Hall Wednesday afternoon to discuss the future of Bradley Lake and the surrounding parkland during a scheduled committee meeting.

item.title: Algoma woman suffers minor injury following vehicle-deer collision
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A 51-year-old Algoma woman was checked by emergency personnel following a collision with a deer Wednesday morning.

item.title: Algoma Public Library Unveils New Logo, Launches Spring Programs
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Algoma Public Library is introducing a fresh look this spring, unveiling a new logo as part of an updated brand identity designed to better reflect the library's role as a modern community hub.

item.title: Middle School Mental Health a Growing Concern across Wisconsin
item.description: Adam Collins -- Middle school represents a critical period of transition for young people, both academically and personally, and Wisconsin mental health leaders say students are facing both difficult and new challenges.

item.title: State legislators follow partisan lines in State of the Union critiques
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Wisconsin legislators wasted no time sharing their thoughts on President Donald Trump's State of the Union address Tuesday.

item.title: United Way stepping up to support Coast Guard members during shutdown
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- With U.S. Coast Guard members across the country potentially missing a paycheck next month due to the partial government shutdown, the United Way of Door County needs your help to ensure they are able to put food on their tables.

item.title: Peninsula Players Offers Scholarships to Door County Arts Students
item.description: Adam Collins -- Peninsula Players Theatre is accepting applications for its annual scholarship program, offering financial support to Door County high school seniors pursuing studies in arts management, music, or theatre.

item.title: Towns to meet about contribution to Algoma fire station
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The towns of Ahnapee, Lincoln and Pierce are inviting residents to weigh in on a proposal from the city of Algoma to contribute to the construction of its new fire station.

item.title: Kewaunee County Food Pantry taps Weidner as new leader
item.description: By TIm Kowols -- A new face is helping guide neighbors in acquiring the necessities they need to put meals on the table.

item.title: Sister Bay seeks feedback on future administration building
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The future of the new Village of Sister Bay administration building is missing one thing: you.
